rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The visible rhinarium apex is predominantly composed of dark (melanin) pixels, estimated at approximately 95%, with negligible pink/pale pixel distribution restricted to the inner nasal margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme mandibular depression exposing the oral cavity, including prominent upper and lower canines and the dorsal surface of the tongue; significant nasolabial skin bunching due to facial contraction.
